K.L. Rahul falls for 1 vs Andhra after being dismissed for 4 in first innings in Ranji Trophy 2026-27
 Ranji Trophy 2026-27: K.L. Rahul scored just one run off 20 balls before Saurabh Kumar dismissed the Karnataka opener against Andhra on Tuesday.
 Updated : Oct 16, 2026 02:28 IST - 1 MIN READ

 K.L. Rahul had a disappointing outing with the bat in round 1 of the Ranji Trophy.
 | Photo Credit: PTI
 K.L. Rahul had a disappointing outing with the bat in round 1 of the Ranji Trophy.
 | Photo Credit: PTI
 India and Karnataka opener K.L. Rahul was dismissed for one off 20 balls by Saurabh Kumar on day three of the Ranji Trophy match against Andhra in Vijayawada on Tuesday.
 Rahul had managed just four runs in the first innings.
 The outing is intended to give Rahul valuable red-ball practice ahead of India’s upcoming tour of New Zealand.
 He will also feature in three red-ball matches for India A on the shadow tour, which begins on October 26 in Lincoln, as he builds towards the two-Test series.
 Rahul’s last Test outing for India was during the Sri Lanka series in August, where he made 135 runs in two matches.
